drivers: US futures are little changed to slightly higher (S&P 500 +0.2%, Nasdaq-100 +0.3%, Dow flat) on Fed decision day, after Tuesday's chip-led gains (Nasdaq-100 +1.3%) tied to Broadcom's $63B bank financing for AI compute. Memory is the theme overnight: SK hynix posted a record quarter (operating profit up ~632% y/y) and a large shareholder-return plan, sending the Kospi up ~6.6%, Samsung up ~5–8% and SK hynix's US shares +6.8%, with MU +3.0% and SNDK +3.4% pre-market; the Nikkei rose 1.1% while Europe is flat to lower (Santander, GSK, Unilever weak; Deutsche Bank higher). Oil is up ~2% (WTI ~$102, Brent ~$115) after an attack on a Saudi refinery and a WSJ report on US planning against Iran; the 10-year is near 5.00% and the dollar near 17-month highs. The FOMC is expected to hold at 3.75%–4.00% at 1:00 p.m. CT (swaps ~9% odds of a hike today, ~80% for December), with focus on dissents and Chair Warsh's 1:30 p.m. press conference. Earnings are heavy: beats at Vertiv, Axogen, Flex, Amphenol, GE HealthCare, Wingstop and Etsy; misses or soft guides at Enphase, Boston Scientific, Smurfit Westrock, Lennox, International Paper, and after Tuesday's close Robinhood, NXP, F5 and Intapp; Microsoft and Alphabet report after the close.
